beaches.name: Filaki (Φυλακή) — Vritomartis naturist beach
beaches.summary: The whole beach is naturist; the operator calls it a compulsory naturist area. Vritomartis, which describes itself as a licensed naturist resort, runs the beach 700 m from the hotel and states that the other beaches it lists nearby are not official naturist beaches. Law 1399/1983 makes nudity lawful on the beach in front of a licensed naturist centre; the licence itself is not published online.

beaches.name: Orthi Ammos (Frangokastello)
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is practised at the eastern end of the beach, below the dunes. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2000 to September 2023; a 2020 report and a 2021 directory entry describe a sign marking the nude section, which a 2023 report says has gone. A Crete beach guide says nudist numbers are falling; who placed the sign is not documented.

beaches.name: Glyka Nera (Sweetwater Beach)
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is practised on the eastern part of the beach, away from the taverna. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 1999 to September 2023; a 2014 report notes a dress-properly sign at the taverna sunbeds, and a 2025 review on a nude-beach map estimates 60% nude further from the boat landing. No designation is documented.

beaches.name: Agia Roumeli (east of the river)
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is practised east of the Samaria river mouth, on the rocky shore. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2001 to 2021; a 2021 directory entry, a Crete beach guide and Greek listicles (2021-2024) also name the ends of the beach. No designation or signage is documented.
